items.headline: Calwise Jr. powers offense, Jackson Jr. leads defense in Louisiana Tech's 41-17 win over Troy
items.description: — Marcus Calwise Jr. caught nine passes for 137 yards and a touchdown and Alonzo Jackson Jr. had a 66-yard scoop-and-score with 1:05 to go to cap off Louisiana Tech's 41-17 rout of Troy on Saturday.

items.headline: Baker throws 3 TD passes to lead Louisiana Tech over South Alabama 35-20
items.description: — Blake Baker threw three touchdown passes and Louisiana Tech shut out South Alabama in the second half for a 35-20 victory on Saturday.
